reply: Your knee is flagged as an active constraint, so I'm swapping the squat and lunges for knee-friendly alternatives. Barbell squat becomes a wide-stance leg press for a more stable knee path, and walking lunges become hip thrusts to hit glutes and hams without knee shear. RDL stays — it's hip-dominant and knee-safe. Volume stays the same across the board.
rationale: Active joint constraint [knee]. Barbell Squat and Walking Lunges are knee-dominant exercises with deep flexion; swapped to wide-stance Leg Press (controlled knee path) and Hip Thrust (hip-dominant, zero knee shear). RDL is hip-hinge dominant and safe. Leg Press already in prescription — swapped to wide stance variant.
